languageSuggestion.title: Choose your language
languageSuggestion.body: You're reading this site in <from/>. Would you rather read it in <to/>?

footer: All processing happens locally in your browser — your files never leave your device

badRequest.title: This request doesn't add up.
badRequest.message: LeClap couldn't make sense of it: the link may be cut short, or edited by hand. Go back and try again from the page itself.

update.title: LeClap was updated while this tab was open.
update.message: This page belongs to the version you opened earlier. Reload to switch to the new one; projects you've saved stay in this browser.

offline.title: You're offline.
offline.message: This page hasn't been saved on this device yet. Reconnect, then reload.
offline.backMessage: Reload to pick up where you left off.

crash.title: Cut! Something broke on our side.
crash.message: LeClap hit an error it didn't see coming. Projects you've saved stay in this browser, so reloading won't touch them.

compileError.missingClip: This template needs at least one clip.
compileError.unreadableClip: One of your clips couldn’t be read: it may be damaged, or in a format this browser can’t open.
compileError.assemblyFailed: The scenes couldn’t be put together into one video.
compileError.engineUnavailable: The video engine couldn’t be downloaded. Reconnect, then try again.
compileError.appUpdated: LeClap was updated since this page opened. Save your work, reload the page, then render again.
compileError.unknown: The render engine reported an error.
